public.in_one_sentence: New or changed OJK rules, sanctions or supervisory actions that change capital, reinsurance, product or reporting duties for insurers.
tell_me_if: OJK issues, drafts or delays a regulation on insurers' capital, solvency, reinsurance, investments or product rules
OJK sanctions, restricts or revokes the licence of an insurer
OJK changes rules for health or motor insurance (pricing, co-payment, claims handling)
Rules for sharia (takaful) units or for the policyholder protection programme change
ignore: Ceremonial events and speeches with no new rule

match.headline: OJK raises minimum capital requirement for general insurers
OJK suspends business of an insurer over capital shortfall
OJK issues new rule on health insurance co-payment

exposure.how_it_reaches_us: Health rules affect pricing and claims.

serious: OJK announces a mandatory capital increase or a ban on a product we sell
private.notes: OJK supervises insurers and has been raising capital and governance expectations.
